answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments establish a verifiable oasis for provenance by binding long-term state to succinct, non-interactive proofs. Identity cloning encounters a reef of computational hardness through sequential VDF primitives that prevent the parallelized pre-computation of ephemeral cryptographic keys. As slashing penalties on high-value staked collateral transform every ember of subversion into negative expected utility, the protocol enforces a robust Nash equilibrium against Byzantine agents.
